name: this portfolio
description: Designed in Figma and built to accompany my CV, this portfolio showcases my work in a way that's both visually engaging and easy to navigate.

name: fusion simulations
description: My masters dissertation explored the scalability and correctness of advanced techniques for neutron transport simulation in fusion reactor geometries.

name: VIVACE
description: Vortex Induced Vibration for Aquatic Clean Energy (VIVACE) was the focus of my undergraduate research. I simulated the system with CFD for comparison with physical results.

name: machine learning
description: I completed a machine learning certification with Python through freeCodeCamp. This was a precursor to recent more in depth work on object detection and classification.

name: sustainability tracking
description: As a consultant I worked to develop a system that monitors companies' social media for sustainability metrics. It used Python to scrape socials and a .NET backend to serve the data.

name: cyber insurance
description: I worked in a team developing a cyber insurance platform to generate quotes for brokers. The system used a .NET backend to serve data to a React frontend, with a SQL database for storage.

name: negotiation training
description: I developed a negotiation competition platform for students of a negotiation course to practise with one another in front of an observer.
